sql: WITH extra AS (SELECT c.oid,c.relname,c.relowner,c.relacl,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname=ANY(ARRAY['hk_funding_schema_migrations','personal_workspaces','sync_changes','sync_conflicts','sync_entities','sync_field_revisions','sync_operation_receipts']::text[])) SELECT clock_timestamp() AS observed_at,current_user AS connection_role,jsonb_build_object('tables',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',e.relname,'technical_owner',pg_get_userbyid(e.relowner),'rls',e.relrowsecurity,'force_rls',e.relforcerowsecurity,'raw_acl',e.relacl::text,'catalog_acl_grants',(SELECT jsonb_agg(x) FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END AS grantee,array_agg(a.privilege_type ORDER BY a.privilege_type) AS privileges,bool_or(a.is_grantable) AS has_explicit_grant_option FROM aclexplode(coalesce(e.relacl,acldefault('r',e.relowner))) a GROUP BY a.grantee) x)) ORDER BY e.relname) FROM extra e),'column_acls',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',e.relname,'column',a.attname,'acl',a.attacl::text)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM extra e JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=e.oid WHERE a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND a.attacl IS NOT NULL),'owner_default_acls',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole),'namespace',d.defaclnamespace::regnamespace::text,'object_type',d.defaclobjtype,'acl',d.defaclacl::text)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_default_acl d WHERE d.defaclrole IN (SELECT relowner FROM extra)),'policies',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',p.tablename,'name',p.policyname,'permissive',p.permissive,'roles',p.roles,'command',p.cmd,'using',p.qual,'with_check',p.with_check) ORDER BY p.tablename,p.policyname) FROM pg_policies p WHERE p.schemaname='public' AND p.tablename IN (SELECT relname FROM extra)),'normal_dependencies',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT e.relname AS referenced_table,pg_describe_object(d.classid,d.objid,d.objsubid) AS dependent_object FROM pg_depend d JOIN extra e ON e.oid=d.refobjid WHERE d.refclassid='pg_class'::regclass AND d.deptype='n' ORDER BY e.relname,dependent_object) x),'connector_public_schema_create',has_schema_privilege(current_user,'public','CREATE')) AS facts
